_comment: Screen-level fidelity for 917:8094 SPX→SGB transfer screen. Harness mirrors all 155 figma nodes by data-figma-id. Tolerances match home/sgb-account screen fidelity (project font aliases, ignore data-driven amounts).
_fontAliasNote: Figma masters label CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; the app ships SpxBrand (PJS Latin + HOST TC CJK merged) — same Huawei TC family for CJK glyphs.
_ignoreTextNote: iOS status-bar mock (clock 9:41) drawn by the figma device frame. Never implemented on web — it's device chrome, not app UI.

deviations.reason: 实收金额 value uses fontWeight 900 (HarmonyOS Sans TC Black) in figma. The app ships only SpxBrand-Bold (700) bundled as the brand face — RN-Web clamps Black to 700. Visual difference imperceptible at 14px. Same 900→700 clamp documented in sgb-account fidelity 2026-05-28.
